changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table donor_record add constraint ck_donor_record_type check (type in ('PERSON', 'COMPANY')) not valid
alter table donor_record add constraint ck_donor_record_variable_symbol check (variable_symbol ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$') not valid
alter table donor_record add constraint ck_donor_record_preferred_locale check (preferred_locale in ('cs', 'en')) not valid

alter table donor_record add constraint ck_donor_record_company_identifier check ((company_identifier is null or (type = 'COMPANY' and company_identifier ~ '^[0-9]{8}$')) and (type <> 'COMPANY' or company_identifier is not null or erased_at is not null)) not valid
alter table bank_payment add constraint ck_bank_payment_currency check (currency = 'CZK') not valid
alter table bank_payment add constraint ck_bank_payment_matching_symbol check (matching_variable_symbol ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$') not valid
alter table donation add constraint ck_donation_status check (status in ('RECEIVED', 'REFUNDED')) not valid
alter table donation add constraint ck_donation_source check (source in ('BANK_TRANSFER', 'MANUAL')) not valid
alter table donation add constraint ck_donation_currency check (currency = 'CZK') not valid
alter table issued_receipt add constraint ck_issued_receipt_locale check (locale in ('cs', 'en')) not valid
alter table donor_record validate constraint ck_donor_record_type
alter table donor_record validate constraint ck_donor_record_variable_symbol
alter table donor_record validate constraint ck_donor_record_preferred_locale
alter table donor_record validate constraint ck_donor_record_company_identifier
alter table bank_payment validate constraint ck_bank_payment_currency
alter table bank_payment validate constraint ck_bank_payment_matching_symbol
alter table donation validate constraint ck_donation_status
alter table donation validate constraint ck_donation_source
alter table donation validate constraint ck_donation_currency
alter table issued_receipt validate constraint ck_issued_receipt_locale

changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table donor_sender_account add constraint uq_donor_sender_account_of_donor unique (id, donor_id)
alter table donor_symbol_claim add constraint uq_donor_symbol_claim_of_donor unique (id, donor_id)
alter table bank_payment add constraint uq_bank_payment_terms unique (id, amount_minor, currency, booked_on)
create index ix_donation_sender_account_of_donor on donation (sender_account_id, donor_id)
create index ix_donation_symbol_claim_of_donor on donation (symbol_claim_id, donor_id)
create index ix_donation_bank_payment_terms on donation (bank_payment_id, amount_minor, currency, received_on)
alter table donation add constraint fk_donation_sender_account_of_donor foreign key (sender_account_id, donor_id) references donor_sender_account (id, donor_id) not valid
alter table donation add constraint fk_donation_symbol_claim_of_donor foreign key (symbol_claim_id, donor_id) references donor_symbol_claim (id, donor_id) not valid

alter table donation add constraint fk_donation_bank_payment_terms foreign key (bank_payment_id, amount_minor, currency, received_on) references bank_payment (id, amount_minor, currency, booked_on) not valid
alter table donation validate constraint fk_donation_sender_account_of_donor
alter table donation validate constraint fk_donation_symbol_claim_of_donor
alter table donation validate constraint fk_donation_bank_payment_terms
alter table donation drop constraint fk_donation_sender_account
alter table donation drop constraint fk_donation_symbol_claim
alter table donation drop constraint fk_donation_bank_payment

changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: create trigger issued_receipt_keeps_its_rows before update or delete on issued_receipt for each row execute function issued_receipt_keeps_what_it_certifies()
create trigger issued_receipt_keeps_its_table before truncate on issued_receipt for each statement execute function issued_receipt_keeps_what_it_certifies()
